newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Princess Diana to attend Singapore dinner for AIDS.
newsitem.headline: Princess Diana to attend Singapore dinner for AIDS.

text.p: Princess Diana is expected to visit Singapore on September 23 for a fund raising dinner for Action For AIDS, fund raisers said on Wednesday.
Diana has been invited by Christina Ong, wife of Singapore business tycoon Ong Beng Seng.
"It is understood Diana will be coming in a private capacity," said a fund raiser who declined to be identified.
There will be a fashion show and the event is expected to be held at the posh Four Seasons hotel, owned by the Ongs, the fund raiser sources said.
The fund raising committee hopes to raise about Singapore $500,000 ($350,000) for Action For AIDS, the sources said.
They said places to dine with Diana were to be sold at S$25,000 and S$10,000 each and several tables have already been snapped up by Singapore's well heeled.
Roy Chan, vice president for Action For AIDS and a member of the fund raising committee, declined to comment on the event.
